name: typescriptlang-org-astro
description: The TypeScript website migrated to Astro

scripts.build: node scripts/compile-documentation.mjs && astro build && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.build:dependencies: pnpm --dir ../typescript-vfs build && pnpm --dir ../ata build && pnpm --dir ../sandbox bootstrap && pnpm --dir ../ts-twoslasher build && pnpm --dir ../sandbox build
scripts.generate:content: pnpm --dir ../documentation bootstrap && pnpm --dir ../glossary build && pnpm --dir ../playground-examples build && pnpm --dir ../playground-handbook build && pnpm --dir ../tsconfig-reference generate:site
scripts.build:site: pnpm generate:content && pnpm build:dependencies && pnpm sync-assets && pnpm build
scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm generate:content && pnpm build:dependencies && pnpm sync-assets && node scripts/compile-documentation.mjs
